headlines.title: Prudential Advisors Welcomes Zachary Karason to Mid America Financial Group
headlines.summary: Prudential Advisors, the wealth management arm of Prudential Financial, Inc. (NYSE: PRU), welcomes Zachary Karason, a Cleveland-based financial advisor with more than 12 years of financial services experience. Responsible for over $106 million in total client assets at U.S. Bancorp Advisors, Karason joins Prudential Advisors through the firm's Mid America Financial Group, headquartered in Columbus, Ohio.

headlines.title: U.S. Bancorp (USB) Expands Business Banking Into Four Sun Belt States
headlines.summary: U.S. Bancorp (NYSE: USB) announced a significant expansion of its business banking operations into Florida, Georgia, Texas, and Arizona. The move targets mid-sized businesses in Sun Belt states where U.S. Bank currently has a limited presence. The expansion includes a sizable hiring effort as the company seeks a broader national footprint. This push by U.S. Bancorp into business hubs in these regions is part of a wider shift by large banks toward faster growing areas.

headlines.title: Major Bank CEO Liquidates Over $1.7 Million Worth of Stock
headlines.summary: Kedia exercised vested stock options at $55.01 per share and immediately sold them at $62.37, retaining a direct stake of 426,262 shares worth approximately $26.6 million.

headlines.title: US Bancorp Expands Business Banking Into Growth States
headlines.summary: US Bancorp expansion is accelerating with 50-plus new client-facing roles across Florida, Georgia, Texas, and Arizona this year.

headlines.title: U.S. Bank's business banking expansion targets the Sun Belt
headlines.summary: Florida, Georgia, Texas and Arizona are all states where U.S. Bank, which operates mainly in the Midwest and the West, sees growth opportunities.

description: U.S. Bancorp, a financial services holding company, provides various financial services to individuals, businesses, institutional organizations, governmental entities, and other financial institutions in the United States. The company operates through Wealth, Corporate, Commercial and Institutional Banking; Consumer and Business Banking; Payment Services; and Treasury and Corporate Support segments. It offers depository services, including checking accounts, savings accounts, and time certificate contracts; and lending services, such as traditional credit products and credit card services, lease financing and import/export trade, agricultural finance, asset-backed lending, and other products. The company also provides cash management, capital markets, and trust and investment management services; and ancillary services comprising capital markets, treasury management, and receivable lock-box collection services to corporate and governmental entity customers. In addition, it offers asset management and fiduciary services for individuals, estates, foundations, business corporations, and charitable organizations; and investment and insurance products to its customers principally within its domestic markets, as well as fund administration services to mutual and other funds. Further, the company provides corporate and purchasing card, and corporate trust services; and credit card services, merchant and ATM processing, mortgage banking, insurance, brokerage and leasing services. U.S. Bancorp was founded in 1863 and is headquartered in Minneapolis, Minnesota.
